sources.snippet: The most notable models in the series currently include: MiniCPM-V 4.6: 🔥🔥🔥 The latest and most efficient model in the MiniCPM-V series. sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V-4.6 is a 1B-parameter multimodal language model from OpenBMB designed for deployment on mobile and edge devices. Built on Qwen3.5-0.8B with a SigLIP2-400M vision encoder, it achieves performance comparable to models twice its size on vision-language benchmarks.
